Q5217.reason: The purchase order is the offer, and Costco’s expressly conditional confirmation is a UCC 2-207 counteroffer that was never accepted, so no contract was formed.

Q6156.reason: The post-termination deposition is hearsay, is not a vicarious admission, and is not former testimony because the wrongful-termination case lacked a similar motive to develop the strict-liability defect issue.

Q8413.reason: The Grand Chamber held that civil state immunity was a proportionate limit compatible with Article 6, so immunity did not violate the right of access to a court.
